name: Hybrid Gaussian Representation with Geometry-Guided Constraints
aliases: Adaptive Hybrid Representation and TensoSDF Constraints
Hybrid Gaussian Splatting with Geometry Guidance
definition: A rendering method that adaptively selects between 2D and 3D Gaussian representations based on local geometry to reduce redundancy in planar structures while maintaining volumetric accuracy, guided by TensoSDF for global geometric consistency.
summary: Hybrid Gaussian Representation with Geometry-Guided Constraints is a 3D Gaussian Splatting technique that adaptively switches between 2D and 3D primitives using TensoSDF constraints to reduce redundancy while maintaining volumetric accuracy.
